LOST Maniyar Math MYSTERY SOLVED! Jarasandha, Mahabharata & 1500-Year-Old Rajgir Temple
The Mystery of Maniyar Math: Dive into the most ancient and mysterious site in Rajgir, Bihar! This vlog explores the incredible Maniyar Math, the cylindrical shrine known locally as the Mani Naga Temple and a key Rajgir Tourist Place.
